Choose awkward high-income piece early versus easy area fill, time a long purchase to collect income but surrender small-patch race, take several low-time turns to monopolize market, preserve gaps for expected shapes.

How to play
Each side empty7×7 quilt, five buttons; shared circular market of18 distinct polyomino patches with printed price, time cost1–6 and income0–3. Marker selects next three available patches; buy one, pay price, rotate/reflect and fit without overlap, marker moves past bought position, own time pawn advances patch cost. Behind pawn always acts next (ties latest arrival), so same player may take consecutive turns. Every passed income milestone pays current sewn income. Instead advance to one beyond rival pawn gaining one button per step. First to cross each of three single-cell bonus milestones gets patch to place. End both reach final time24; score buttons minus2 per empty quilt cell.
Higher final score wins; equal draws. Cannot end early while behind unless advancing through rival, as action rule states.

A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Keep high rank for showdown but risk guess, use inspection now or shield future, choose forced redraw to remove dangerous high card, trade away exposed identity. Retained card is both win value and future action resource.

Take a seat
How to play
Three players each hold one hidden card; deck ranks1–8 with multiplicities5/2/2/2/2/1/1/1 (sixteen cards). At turn draw second and play one for its printed effect:1 guess another hand rank excluding1 (correct eliminates);2 privately inspect other hand;3 compare hands privately (lower eliminated);4 shield until next turn;5 force target discard/redraw;6 exchange hands;7 no effect but must play if held with5 or6;8 played/discarded eliminates self. One undealt card hidden to prevent complete certainty. Eliminated cards public. When stock empty, highest retained rank among survivors earns token; last survivor earns immediately. First three tokens wins.
Three favor tokens wins; first rival to three loses; simultaneous threshold ties broken next round. Tied highest survivors each earn a token; if the match lead at three is tied, continue until a unique leader.
